title: From bamboo to biochar: a critical review of bamboo pyrolysis conditions and products with a focus on relevance to the developing world
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2712-2732
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00800F, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Elish Chambers, Matthew Hassall, Dominic Johnson, Conall Mcgoran, Olivia Williams, Aden Blair, Freddie Catlow, Basudeb Saha
This innovative study explores bamboo pyrolysis for biochar production, critically evaluating methods and emphasising advanced separation techniques for syngas, including both condensable (bio-oil) and non-condensable gases.
